summary: Unexpected invoice charge after quota threshold change
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports an unexpected invoice increase after they adjusted their quota threshold on 2026-03-09. Impact: higher-than-expected charge reported in invoice for billing period ending 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-09. Environment: prod (us-east).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Navigate to account -> billing -> quota settings.
2) Toggle quota threshold from 1M tokens to 2M tokens (customer reports this was performed via the Console UI on 2026-03-09).
3) Observe subsequent invoice generated 2026-03-10 which includes a charge labeled "overage adjustment" with an unexpectedly large amount.

Logs / evidence:
- Customer attached invoice PDF (referenced in comments).
- Billing ledger snapshot: invoice_82419 shows overage line item for 1.1M tokens at unexpected rate.
- Console change event for account maple-health: quota_update by user@maplehealth.com on 2026-03-09 17:42 UTC.

Hypothesis: quota change did not trigger correct proration logic or legacy billing rate applied after threshold change. Possible mis-sync between quota-service and invoicing pipeline during the 2026-03-09 deploy window.

Requested outcome: investigate proration and rate-finding logic, confirm whether charge is valid; issue refund or credit if billing error; update customer and provide root cause and mitigation plan.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Ethan Brooks: Created ticket. Customer provided invoice PDF and screen recording of quota change. Asked for priority review; customer is on dedicated plan.
2026-03-10 11:05 - Jordan Lee: Assigned to me. I will pull billing ledgers and check quota-change events. Can you share customer account id and the invoice PDF in this ticket?

2026-03-11 14:20 - Support Engineer (Maya Chen): Found that invoicing job v2.3.1 ran during the deploy window on 2026-03-09; there is a known edge-case where proration lookup falls back to default rate if quota metadata is missing. Investigating whether metadata write failed for this account.
2026-03-12 08:33 - Finance (Luis Ortega): Noted an unusual overage line. Placed a provisional credit hold while investigation proceeds. Awaiting engineering confirmation before final credit/refund.

2026-03-15 10:02 - Jordan Lee: Confirmed root cause: quota-service emitted update event but the metadata store returned a 500 for a short interval; invoicing job retried and fell back to legacy rate mapping. Working on hotfix to ensure invoices retry rate-lookup instead of defaulting. Proposed mitigation: immediate manual credit and follow-up release to billing pipeline.
